title: Lecture 5: Tuples, Lists, Aliasing, Mutability, and Cloning

segments.text: Start with concrete collections of values and compare a tuple with a list that contains the same elements.
Run indexing, slicing, and update operations line by line. Ask which operation fails for an immutable tuple and why.
Draw two variable names pointing to the same list. This visual picture introduces the formal idea of aliasing.
Show a surprising error: updating one alias also changes what the other name observes. Trace the shared object to explain it.
Contrast aliasing with cloning by changing one element and checking both lists after each operation.
Practice predicting mutation effects, give feedback using an object diagram, and transfer the rule to nested lists.
